## Summary

## Validation

- [ ] `composer test` passes
- [ ] `composer analyse` passes
- [ ] Code style is formatted
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes
- [ ] README/configuration docs were updated when public behavior changed

## Compatibility

Document supported Laravel/PHP impact, breaking changes, migration steps, or configuration changes.
